study_type: Reference-informed forward computational benchmark. Generated event records, not empirical accident reports or a population-calibrated generator.
development_history: v3.2 revises the event and observation process after diagnostic review. It retains fixed seeds and paired scenarios, replaces direct outcome-dependent recording with an outcome-blind pre-outcome complexity/report-quality process, adds clustered count outcomes, heterogeneous contexts and mixed reporting precision, and reruns every analysis under one final protocol.

generator.context_status: Stress-oriented scenario composition chosen for mechanisms, not estimated accident population frequencies.
generator.loss_components: Property damage, casualty-related expenditure and response/aftermath cost are generated forward with event-level shocks. Total loss is reported with a mixed precision process and is never clipped or resampled to satisfy a label.
generator.observation_process: Recorded factors depend on pre-outcome event complexity, context and report quality. Fatalities and loss are not read when generating the assessment mask.

model_protocol.selection: Target-development mean log loss; macro-F1 breaks ties. Same target folds for all primary arms, including source-trained target-selected reference.
model_protocol.convergence: Log every failed attempt. Retry same configuration at larger budget; exclude unresolved CV candidates; unresolved final fits stop the run. No test-based fallback or selection.

coverage: All primary models run in every repeat/scenario on recorded factors. Complete-factor, count-only and contextual logistic controls use fixed C=0.3. Context includes post-event fields and is a diagnostic, not a deployable forecast.
estimands: Mean accuracy, macro-F1, log loss and multiclass Brier under each specified DGP. Paired mean differences vs pooling with Monte Carlo standard errors and t intervals across independent repeats. Neither these intervals nor single-draw intervals establish real-world validity.
invariants: assessment mask does not use fatalities or loss
loss precision is independent of label thresholds
primary_predictors: Outcome-blind recorded factor flags. Complete factors, context and the assessment mask are retained only for mechanism diagnostics.
scenario_interpretation: Covariate shift changes context and factor prevalence. Conditional shift changes injury vulnerability while leaving the pre-outcome event-factor process paired. The primary observation process is outcome-blind; any remaining association between recording count and severity is induced by shared event mechanisms rather than direct label access.
